label.description: Visible label. It also names the control.

value.description: Controlled value. Leave it out for uncontrolled use.

onValueChange.description: Called whenever a tick passes the needle, including while coasting.

onValueCommit.description: Called once the tape comes to rest after a drag, flick, tap, scroll, or key.

step.description: Value of one small tick. The tape always rests on a tick.

largeStep.description: Distance for PageUp, PageDown, and Shift with an arrow. Defaults to one labelled tick (step × majorEvery).

spacing.description: Pixels between small ticks. Wider spacing gives finer control.

format.description: Formats the readout, the tick labels, and aria-valuetext.

unit.description: Unit shown after the readout and spoken with the value, such as "cm".

name.description: Submits the value with a form through a hidden input.

disabled.description: Blocks input and removes the control from the tab order.
